description: What PLAN_PANDAFOOT.md's Phase 1 says, each written for the screens of a management game

input.natural_language: A football manager's squad screen: a framed panel of the players in columns, the names cut to their column, the strength yellow for the best, the wages as money, the balance red when below zero

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="squad" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="frame" src="projects/pandafoot/assets/frame.png" tile="24" slice="8" />
  <q:set name="balance" value="-25000" type="number" />
  <q:set name="players" value="{[ {'name': 'Rafael Moreira', 'pos': 'MF', 'strength': 49, 'salary': 58580}, {'name': 'Foguete', 'pos': 'FW', 'strength': 41, 'salary': 22290}, {'name': 'Tatu', 'pos': 'DF', 'strength': 32, 'salary': 16531} ]}" type="array" />
  <q:function name="money" params="n">
    <q:return value="{('-$' if n < 0 else '$') + thousands(abs(round(n)), '.')}" />
  </q:function>
  <qg:scene name="squad" width="640" height="400" background="#0000a8">
    <!-- an 80 by 25 text screen: a monospaced font, panels where they go -->
    <qg:hud x="8" y="8" box="frame" font="projects/pandafoot/assets/DejaVuSansMono.ttf" size="13">
      <qg:text value="{'SQUAD   ' + str(len(players)) + ' players'}" color="#ffff55" />
      <qg:table source="{players}" as="p">
        <qg:column label="Name" value="{p.name}" width="12" />
        <qg:column label="Pos" value="{p.pos}" width="4" />
        <qg:column label="Str" value="{p.strength}" width="3" align="right" color="{'#ffff55' if p.strength >= 42 else '#ffffff'}" />
        <qg:column label="Salary" value="{money(p.salary)}" width="9" align="right" />
      </qg:table>
    </qg:hud>
    <qg:hud x="8" y="370" font="projects/pandafoot/assets/DejaVuSansMono.ttf" size="13">
      <qg:text value="{'Balance: ' + fit(money(balance), 12, 'right')}" color="{'#55ff55' if balance >= 0 else '#ff5555'}" />
    </qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

input.natural_language: A shop: a button for each of the goods in a list, only those not sold out; buying one takes one from its stock and counts how many of it were bought

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="shop" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <q:set name="gold" value="100" type="number" />
  <q:set name="goods" value="{[ {'name': 'Potion', 'price': 10, 'stock': 3}, {'name': 'Rope', 'price': 4, 'stock': 1}, {'name': 'Lamp', 'price': 25, 'stock': 0} ]}" type="array" />
  <q:set name="bought" value="{ {} }" />
  <qg:scene name="shop" width="320" height="240">
    <qg:menu x="16" y="40" source="{goods}" as="g" size="12">
      <!-- one button, shown for each row; the row is g in its label, its if= and what it runs -->
      <qg:button label="{fit(g.name, 8) + fit(g.price, 4, 'right') + '  x' + str(g.stock)}" if="{g.stock > 0}">
        <q:if condition="{gold >= g.price}">
          <q:set name="gold" value="{gold - g.price}" />
          <q:set name="g.stock" value="{g.stock - 1}" />
          <q:set name="bought" index="{g.name}" value="{(bought[g.name] if g.name in bought else 0) + 1}" />
        </q:if>
      </qg:button>
    </qg:menu>
    <qg:hud position="top-right"><qg:text value="{'Gold ' + str(gold)}" /></qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

input.natural_language: A new world made from its number: the same number gives the same clubs, drawn as the scene is entered; a little name generator, and the strongest club announced

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="world" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <q:set name="world" value="7" type="number" />
  <q:set name="clubs" value="[]" type="array" />
  <q:function name="club_name">
    <q:if condition="{chance(0.3)}"><q:return value="{pick(['Real', 'Atlético', 'Sporting']) + ' ' + pick(['Panda', 'Bambu', 'Coala'])}" /></q:if>
    <q:return value="{pick(['Panda', 'Bambu', 'Coala', 'Lontra']) + ' ' + pick(['FC', 'EC', 'United'])}" />
  </q:function>
  <q:function name="strongest">
    <q:set name="top" value="{clubs[0]}" />
    <q:loop items="{clubs}" var="c"><q:if condition="{c.power > top.power}"><q:set name="top" value="{c}" /></q:if></q:loop>
    <q:return value="{top}" />
  </q:function>
  <!-- seed= an expression: the world's number, read as the scene is entered -->
  <qg:scene name="draw" width="320" height="240" seed="{world}">
    <q:set name="drawn" value="{[club_name(), club_name(), club_name()]}" type="array" />
    <q:set name="clubs" value="{[ {'name': drawn[0], 'power': round(random(20, 50))}, {'name': drawn[1], 'power': round(random(20, 50))}, {'name': drawn[2], 'power': round(random(20, 50))} ]}" />
    <qg:hud position="top-left">
      <qg:text value="{'World ' + str(world) + ': ' + join(drawn, ', ')}" />
      <qg:text value="{repeat('=', 20)}" />
      <qg:text value="{'The favourite: ' + strongest().name}" />
    </qg:hud>
    <qg:on-input action="select"><q:set name="world" value="{world + 1}" /><qg:goto-scene name="draw" /></qg:on-input>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

input.natural_language: A new game's form: the settings in one menu and the clubs to choose in another beside it; down from the last setting goes on into the clubs, and the start button below them

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="newgame" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <q:set name="world" value="1" type="number" />
  <q:set name="who" value="" />
  <q:set name="club" value="-1" type="number" />
  <q:set name="names" value='["Panda FC", "Bambu United", "Coala City"]' type="array" />
  <qg:scene name="new-game" width="640" height="400">
    <!-- menus shown together are one column for the keys, in this order -->
    <qg:menu x="16" y="40" size="13">
      <qg:slider label="World" bind="world" min="1" max="999" step="1" />
      <qg:field label="Manager" bind="who" />
    </qg:menu>
    <qg:menu x="340" y="40" source="{[0, 1, 2]}" as="i" size="13">
      <qg:button label="{('> ' if club == i else '  ') + names[i]}"><q:set name="club" value="{i}" /></qg:button>
    </qg:menu>
    <qg:menu x="16" y="330" size="13">
      <qg:button label="Start" if="{club >= 0}"><qg:goto-scene name="league" /></qg:button>
    </qg:menu>
  </qg:scene>
  <qg:scene name="league" />
</q:application>
